provenance.x11_to_hid: msi-perkeyrgb protocol_data/msi_keymaps.py, the ['GS65'] table (MIT, Askannz): the GE63 family table plus Home (X11 110 -> HID 74) and End (X11 115 -> HID 77).
provenance.groups: nav grows to six keys because Home and End have their own LEDs on this chassis.
provenance.validated: Not lit by this plugin yet; upstream lists GS65 as working.

notes.nav: Six keys: Insert, Home, PgUp, Delete, End, PgDn. On the GE63 family Home and End are Fn-layer functions with no LED.
notes.numpad: The GS65 Stealth Thin has no numpad. The KP_ names are inherited from the family table and light nothing here.
